blocks.label: Practice
blocks.instructions:
Bearing Watch — PracticeA contact will appear on the bearing display on each trial.
  • Click when you detect the Port contact (left side, ~90°)
  • Do nothing for the Starboard contact (right side, ~270°)
  • Both contacts appear equally often
  • You have 1 second to respond
  • Feedback will tell you if you were correct

blocks.label: Main Task
blocks.instructions:
Bearing WatchContinue responding to Port contacts only.
  • Port contacts are now less frequent — stay alert
  • No feedback in this block
